text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I went to the café and 
saw Air Groove talking with a female 
student about something.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
How does it look, Senpai? I feel like 
today's hamburg steak turned out pretty 
well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's better than last time. But the sauce 
is too salty."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If the meat is already seasoned during 
prep, then the sauce should be a bit 
lighter.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's very helpful! I'll make 
sure it's even more delicious next time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are definitely improving. Keep up 
the hard work.
The female student happily walked away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A taste test. Apparently, giving my 
honest feedback serves as helpful 
reference material."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Every so often, students who want my 
feedback will bring over their boxed 
lunches."

Air Groove spoke, looking at the array of 
bento boxes laid out before her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦ Well, I understand what you're 
trying to say, butâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's what they expressly wished for. 
Besides, it's not like it's more than I 
can eat.
choice_data_list: Even so, I think that's way too much food.
We won't have any trouble finding lunch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... after telling everyone to leave 
it to me, it'd be awkward to go around 
returning it all...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That has nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's the bed I made. If an apology is to 
be given, I'll go alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, look... I'll at least thank you for 
the offer.

Afterward, Air Groove went around 
returning the bento boxes, apologizing to 
each and every person.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was never in any trouble regarding lunch 
in the first place. I'm just doing this 
because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether it is training or cooking, the 
spirit to strive for improvement is truly 
admirable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's only natural as the elder one. 
It's nothing particularly worth boasting 
about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which bento should I start with 
today...?

Air Groove began eating the boxed lunch 
she'd chosen, her expression softening 
with an unmistakable gentle warmth.
